items.title: Stanley Kay interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 18, 2001
items.q: "you are my friend" ... "we worked together. But you are Snooky Young. And I saw you play in the Lunceford band and I know you."

ctx.x: And we talk, and I’m happy for those guys, and Zoot and Al Cohn and Sweets. Sweets was my idol. Harry Edison. You know from the Basie band. And it meant a lot to me. I once said, recently, Snooky Young came in. You know who he is?
